headline: Discovery and event plans redesigned; verified locally, not deployed.
summary: Owner asks for stronger product design, event atmosphere, less text and easier nearby discovery/joining. Gesture suggestions are exploratory, not rules. The team is choosing the interaction autonomously against comprehension and useful real-world participation, not novelty alone.

Implemented bold sport invitations, finite Previous/Next browsing, grid alternative, compact filters and visible approximate scope. Event details now share the poster style, concise logistics/timezone, About this plan disclosure and request controls before the map on mobile. Existing explicit request flow and eligibility/location controls remain. Pending confirmation explains host review and cancellation.

Research reviewed working patterns from Partiful Explore, Luma Discover and DICE: event-first presentation, category entry points and separation of browsing from commitment. No copied artwork, fake event supply, invented social proof or measured conversion gains.

Verified 1,205 web tests (14 skipped), typecheck, lint with no errors, production builds and actual-page synthetic browser checks at 390px normal/reduced motion and 1280px. Keyboard request resolves to pending with confirmation focus; no private address appears. No real requests, events or account mutations. Discovery specialist and coordinator completed their design slices.

Production remains approved release d7064b7; current design/signup/HQ and isolated chat/host work are not deployed. Unattended CLI worker is fault-latched after an explicit usage limit, not working in the background. Host-edit work is preserved; no paid fallback, purchase or resume. Next: verify retained host-edit changes and assemble an exact release candidate. Continuous unattended work cannot be claimed until model capacity is restored.
